No other section changes; no node, edge or PMR id changes.

owner_decision: docs/ops/owner-ratifications/FIBDB053_D1_AUDITOR_PREPHASE2_HARDENING_OWNER_DECISION_v1.0.0.json + owner R5 (ADOPT_FOCUSED_RECERT_NB_A/C/F = YES; NB_E = ACCEPT_AS_NONBLOCKING_REDUNDANCY; NB_G = ACCEPT_AS_FAIL_CLOSED_NONBLOCKING; SIGNED)
CERTIFIED_BLOBS_UNCHANGED: The v3 tools (mint 601f1f96..., probe 86cbda48...), their source templates and the shared trust text, the pinned project certificate and CHANNEL_BINDING.tools/.tls are byte-identical to b4ca05ac: eligible for certification inheritance. The launcher build changed (it now also pins the outer boundary), so its prior PEB evidence is re-run for R5.

CHANNEL_BINDING.launcher_build_rule: Unchanged rule; re-derived for R5: the launcher plan now also carries preNodeOuterBoundarySha256 (the outer cmd boundary is pinned), which changed the launcher closure digest. Its OC-13/OC-15 behaviour is unchanged.
CHANNEL_BINDING.versioned_files: The v3 tools have their own file names; v1 and v2 files are left in place, unchanged, so 979b1440 and fa43b396 stay reproducible.
CHANNEL_BINDING.invalidation: TOOL_BINDING unchanged: any other byte of a tool, of the launcher build or of the CA file is another channel.

OC-12: probe planning without a certification of the channel as pinned
mint planning without closed OEP-1 evidence
EXECUTION_PROCEDURE.the_only_authorized_command: C:\WINDOWS\System32\cmd.exe /d /c "<channel-dir>\d1-pre-node-outer-boundary.cmd" "<channel-dir>\plan-<mode>.json"  (printed by the gate; the OUTER cmd sanitizes PSModulePath and every CLR profiler / startup-hook input before any PowerShell starts, then runs the pinned inner script; a direct `node <launcher>` start is NOT an authorized operator channel and the launcher refuses it, OC-15)

PRE_NODE_BOUNDARY.why: The focused recert of b4ca05ac measured that an attacker-controlled PSModulePath can compromise the PowerShell boundary before its security-sensitive cmdlets run, and that a CLR profiler / startup hook injects managed code into the PowerShell process at CLR start. A check inside an already-compromised process is not sufficient (owner R5 A).

outer_boundary.runs_in: C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe /d (native, not a CLR process; /d disables AutoRun)
outer_boundary.launches: the pinned inner PowerShell script and node by ABSOLUTE paths (SystemRoot for powershell.exe, %~dp0 for the script); never through PATH resolution

inner_boundary.trust_decisions: made only with .NET APIs and language primitives (System.Environment, System.IO.File, System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256, System.Diagnostics.Process), never an autoloadable cmdlet a poisoned PSModulePath could shadow; PSModulePath is cleared before any command that could autoload
inner_boundary.refuses: every Node/OpenSSL/loader input (PRE_NODE_HOSTILE_SOURCE) and every CLR profiler / startup-hook input present at entry (PRE_NODE_INJECTION_SOURCE); PSModulePath is not refused on mere presence (PowerShell always populates it) but is sanitized by the outer boundary and neutralized by the .NET-only trust path
inner_boundary.starts_node_with: no flags, an environment built from the allowlist only, plus the boundary mark (the inner script sha256)

PRE_NODE_BOUNDARY.launcher_side: OC-15 (defence in depth, not the boundary): the launcher refuses to prompt unless it carries the boundary mark, has no execArgv and sees no NODE_* variable.
PRE_NODE_BOUNDARY.measured_by: tests/custody/d1-pre-node-boundary.test.ts: the module-shadowing attack is armed as a control, executes nothing through the boundary (0 module, 0 trojan), the CLR profiler / startup-hook inputs are refused at entry and cleared by the outer cmd before PowerShell, and the preload attack of R4 still refuses with 0 preload executions.
PRE_NODE_BOUNDARY.cannot_defend: LD_PRELOAD on cmd.exe itself, or a compromised OS.
PRE_NODE_BOUNDARY.measured_on_this_host: NODE_USE_SYSTEM_CA is present in this host tool environment; the boundary refuses it. The outer cmd tests run under real cmd.exe + Windows PowerShell on this Windows host; the module-shadowing and profiler-refusal tests also run under pwsh on Linux CI.

EXPLICIT_NON_AUTHORIZATIONS: No hosted connection, no hosted OEP-1, no mint, no deposit, no delivery.
No certification event is written by this lane (the b4ca05ac event is not materialized).
HC-1 is not requested; N11 is not authorized.
